title: Fix TAA transfer usage + descriptor image layouts + ensure draw bracketing
rationale: Remaining VUIDs indicate: (1) copies from images missing TRANSFER_SRC (06662); (2) descriptor imageLayout vs actual layout mismatches, plus storage view spanning all mips causing GENERAL vs SRV conflicts (09600/00344); (3) occasional draws outside active dynamic rendering (renderpass VUID).

edits.action: Add VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT to m_taaCurrentImage usage; keep history image with TRANSFER_DST_BIT

Verify all image transitions occur outside dynamic rendering; ensure current -> TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, history -> TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL; after copy, transition both back to SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL before sampling

Create a dedicated storage image view restricted to mip 0 (levelCount=1) for compute writes (layout GENERAL) and use that in the compute descriptor; keep a separate sampled image view spanning all mips for rendering
Audit that every vkCmdDraw is bracketed by vkCmdBeginRendering/vkCmdEndRendering; after the first EndRendering to render TAA off-screen, ensure subsequent draws begin a new rendering instance

acceptance: No VUID 06662 when updating TAA history (copy source usage fixed or transitions correct)
No VUID 09600/00344 related to descriptor imageLayout or mip-level GENERAL vs SRV conflicts
No 'vkCmdDraw must be inside an active render pass' VUIDs across the frame
notes: If you later remove copies entirely (A3), you may drop TRANSFER_SRC usage for m_taaCurrentImage.
Keep all vkCmdPipelineBarrier/vkCmdCopyImage outside any active dynamic rendering instance
